== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
On 15 August 2008 the Players Committee renamed the existing Set 8 Effect to Luke’s Ultimatum. Its rules text remains the same. The announcement separately says the earlier Ultimatum and Resistance titles will appear as Defensive Shields in Set 16. The recovered full-card header shows the renamed Set 8 Effect.
